integrity: Proof and all-parameter transfer polynomial are self-contained except for the explicitly cited homology-concentration theorem. A finite standalone checker is supplemental and not a proof for infinite parameters.
scientific_limitations: Actual rational homology characters are computed only when the cycle length is divisible by three, using a published pure-degree concentration theorem. At other lengths the result is a virtual alternating character. No integral torsion or dihedral-equivariant classification is asserted. Literature comparisons cannot exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: Color-permutation homology characters of categorical cycle–clique products
